name: Terminal
description: A shell and an agent in a tile beside your notes. Each is a row that says what runs: fork it to change the agent, or add a row for another program.

tiles.name: Shell
tiles.description: your login shell in a terminal beside your notes: every key goes to it until the key that leaves (the native window draws it when it is built with its terminal: cargo build --features pty)

tiles.name: Agent
tiles.description: an agent in a terminal beside your notes: your shell, with the agent's command typed into it (the native window draws it when it is built with its terminal: cargo build --features pty)
